content.value_statement: Understanding an unfamiliar codebase can require searching many files and tracing data flow. This skill produces factual maps of CookMode V2 components, locations, and interactions without proposing unrequested changes.
actual_capabilities: Explain the documented CookMode V2 architecture and project structure.
Identify documented component, hook, utility, and database-table locations.
Describe the documented recipe state and real-time data flow.
Map documented interactions between React components and Supabase.
Present factual implementation notes in structured Markdown.
limitations: Covers only information available in the CookMode V2 source and documentation.
Does not modify files, run the application, or validate runtime behavior.
Does not suggest improvements unless the request explicitly asks for them.
File locations can become outdated when the upstream project changes.

use_cases.title: Orient a new developer
use_cases.description: Find the main components, hooks, and data flow before making a first contribution.
use_cases.target_user: Developers joining the CookMode V2 project

use_cases.title: Prepare technical documentation
use_cases.description: Create a factual explanation of a feature, its locations, and its dependencies.

use_cases.title: Trace a product question
use_cases.description: Identify where a recipe workflow or real-time update is documented in the codebase.

prompt_templates.title: Find a component
prompt_templates.prompt: Where is RecipeModal implemented, and what does it do?

prompt_templates.title: Explain data flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how recipe data moves from local state to Supabase.

prompt_templates.title: Map a feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Document the recipe scaling feature. Include what it does, where it is implemented, how it works, and related components.

prompt_templates.title: Trace dependencies
prompt_templates.prompt: Map the documented dependencies and interactions for real-time recipe updates. Include relevant hooks, components, and database behavior.

output: Location: RecipeModal provides the slider and scaling.js provides amount calculations.
Interaction: Recipe state stores order counts and persists them through Supabase.
useRecipeData manages ingredients, steps, and status.

best_practices: Ask for a specific feature, component, or workflow when possible.
Request file locations and interactions for a complete technical map.
Verify cited locations against the current branch before editing code.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the skill as proof of current runtime behavior.
Do not request design recommendations when you only need factual documentation.
Do not rely on historical references after major project restructuring.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It explains the documented CookMode V2 implementation, including architecture, files, and data flow.

faq.question: Does it change the codebase?
faq.answer: No. It is a documentation-only skill and does not modify project files.

faq.question: Can it explain a specific feature?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for a feature and request its purpose, locations, implementation, and interactions.

faq.question: Does it recommend refactoring?
faq.answer: Not by default. It stays factual unless you explicitly request recommendations.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: How current is the information?
faq.answer: It reflects the referenced CookMode V2 source. Confirm details against the current branch when accuracy is critical.
